Areas served on Montreal’s South Shore

From Châteauguay to Varennes and from Saint-Lambert to Saint-Jean-sur-Richelieu, we deliver to every city on the South Shore, including the industrial areas of Boucherville, Longueuil, Saint-Hubert and Candiac. Deliveries between the South Shore and the island of Montreal or the North Shore are done the same day.

FAQ

FAQ — montreal south shore delivery

Do you deliver between the South Shore and Montreal the same day?

Yes. With express service, a Brossard–Montreal or Boucherville–Laval delivery is done the same day, bridges included.

Do you cover Saint-Jean-sur-Richelieu and Châteauguay?

Yes, as well as the rest of Montérégie further south or east on request, scheduled or next day.

Do you do moves on the South Shore?

Yes, on weekends, with an equipped truck, fuel and mileage included. See our moving page.

Can you unload a container at a warehouse in Boucherville?

Yes, our handling crew goes to every industrial park on the South Shore.
